style.backgroundSystem: one flat controlled field per screen and never two in one: frost-white #F2F7FC seamless field for the packshot, the material screen and the empty spec grid, ice-blue #8FB6DF CG step-stage field for the benefit hero, the variant screen and the close, deep indigo-slate #2E4664 full-bleed field for the pain-point split, the macro board and the icon matrix; no scenic depth, no gradient sky, no curtain or room architecture
style.direction: cool clinical ice-blue men's underwear studio commerce
style.iconSystem: single-weight hollow thin-line icons only, drawn as outlines in #2E4664 on frost-white #F2F7FC or in #F2F7FC on deep indigo-slate #2E4664, arranged in a two-row by three-column matrix, plus empty circle outlines and four-corner framing brackets as the only graphic devices; no filled badges, no shields, no seals, no award or certification marks
style.lightingSystem: cool even studio light around 6000K, broad front-left softbox key with a fill card on the shadow side, low contrast, soft contact shadow that always grounds the floating garment, grazing light only inside the macro screen, no harsh speculars and no blown highlights
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool clinical men's underwear commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of frost-white studio field #F2F7FC, ice-blue CG step stage #8FB6DF, deep indigo-slate information field #2E4664 and one warm cotton-husk accent #A8703C; cool even studio light around 6000K with a broad front-left softbox key, fill card on the shadow side and a soft contact shadow that always grounds the garment; matte lacquered circular tiered step stage and fluted column plinth as the only set pieces; modern geometric sans-serif for every rendered line with one thin letter-spaced English kicker; single-weight hollow thin-line icons in a two-row three-column matrix, outlined capsule tags, empty circle outlines and four-corner brackets only, never filled badges or seals; garment floating on an invisible form, laid flat or shown in tight macro at a stable centre-weighted scale with the front panel left plain and unmarked; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no model, no invented certification or sales artwork.
noDrift: no palette changes outside the four locked hexes
no mixed fonts, no handwritten or serif lettering
no scenic, curtain or gradient backgrounds
no model, face, limbs or body parts in frame
no embossed badge, shield, seal or certification artwork
no invented percentages, test standards, yarn counts or sales figures
style.presentationRules: three locked scales only: the garment floating on an invisible form with a soft contact shadow, the garment laid flat on one plane, and the tight macro reading of one construction edge; identical front orientation and centre-weighted scale between screens, waistband kept horizontal, leg openings never clipped, the front panel kept plain and unmarked, and no screen ever mixes a flat-lay scale with a floating scale
style.surfaceSystem: matte lacquered circular tiered step stage and a matching fluted column plinth, pale frost-white seamless counter board for flat lay and macro boards, matte deep indigo-slate insert board, no concrete, no wood, no fabric drape as a surface
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif as the single family, one bold two-line Chinese display headline plus one thin letter-spaced English kicker, one outlined capsule tag and one dash-flanked sub-line, headline 26-42pt, label 12-16pt, every rendered Chinese string comes from a selling_point or callout placeholder slot and never from source copy
